verdict.rationale: Google Cloud does maintain a public status page with per-service status and a 'Personalized Service Health' feature for incident details (google-cloud-docs-17, docs-23), which is the claimed capability. However, multiple independent community reports concretely contradict its reliability as an outage-transparency surface: the status page reportedly showed all-green 'Available' markers during active outages, incident acknowledgment was delayed by ~35min-1hr, and in one case the status-page infrastructure itself was hosted on the affected GCP systems, delaying incident reporting (google-cloud-comm-12, comm-13, comm-16, comm-18). Missing for 10: verifiable per-service historical uptime logs, published post-incident reports (postmortems) in the evidence, and any rebuttal/fix evidence showing these accuracy issues were resolved.
